sourceEnglishSpeaking: Practice the guide's six-inch overlap phrase and verify it against the selected product instructions.
candidateObjective: ルーフィングの重ね幅を測り、製品の施工説明書で指定値を確認する。
candidateFocus: ～ずに expresses an absence of wrinkles; ～で marks the fastening material. ～によると attributes the six-inch example to the guide, while 製品の施工説明書で確認する asks for the selected product's value.

archivedSpeaking.opening: ガイドの例では重ね幅は六インチです。この製品の施工説明書では何インチですか。
archivedSpeaking.goal: Practice the guide's six-inch overlap phrase and verify it against the selected product instructions.

curriculumAdaptationNote: Preserve the current source sequence: yesterday the crew cleaned the deck, today it rolls out underlayment straight without wrinkles, the foreman recalls a guide's six-inch example and verifies the selected manufacturer's instructions, a worker remeasures the overlap, then the crew fastens with plastic-cap nails. Six inches is not a universal specification. Archived Japanese may narrow generic underlayment/felt and fasteners to asphalt/resin products; hold those faces for qualified source/roofing review. Current curriculum has no authored verb-example list; archived forms remain conditional evidence. No selected learner/audio text or progress identity is created.

cards.reviewNote: Source underlayment / sub-capa is generic, while archived ルーフィング may narrow to asphalt roofing felt. Confirm the product class before selecting a trade term.

cards.archivedJapanese: アスファルトフェルト
cards.reviewNote: Felt paper / papel de fieltro is a material category. Archived アスファルトフェルト specifies asphalt felt; confirm material before selecting this narrower face.
Plastic cap nails / clavos con tapa plástica should not imply a specific resin product. Confirm 樹脂キャップ付き釘 against the job's fastener specification.
